summary: A cursed light scroll darkens the room while the hero wields a lit Sunsword. C passes that artifact light to impact_arti_light() and consumes obj_resists() before deciding whether to change its BUC state. JavaScript's litroom() leaves the artifact light alone without invoking the helper, shifting RNG at the following boundary.

source.branch: read.c:litroom(), when turning light off for a cursed light scroll, visits carried lit artifact lights and calls impact_arti_light(obj, TRUE, !Blind); that helper skips already-cursed objects or calls obj_resists(obj, 25, 75) before the BUC dip.
callers: js/read.js:seffect_light() -> litroom() currently omits the helper call

evidence: nethack-c/upstream/src/read.c:1741-1755: seffect_light() calls litroom(!scursed, sobj) for an uncursed or cursed, non-confused scroll.
nethack-c/upstream/src/read.c:2491-2531: litroom(FALSE, obj) walks carried objects; for a lit artifact_light() it calls impact_arti_light(otmp, TRUE, !Blind) and leaves the artifact lit.

nethack-c/upstream/src/potion.c:1595-1618: impact_arti_light() returns for an already-cursed artifact or calls obj_resists(obj, 25, 75); a non-resisting artifact is dipped in cursed water through H2Opotion_dip().

js/read.js:2051-2060 and 2080-2090: litroom() comments that artifact BUC transitions belong to impact_arti_light(), but its darkening loop only skips snuff_lit() for artifact lights and never calls the helper.
